description: Returns the current mid-market exchange rate between two currencies as the number of units of to_currency per one unit of from_currency, with the time it was read. Use it to answer how much one currency is worth in another. It does not say whether Morse can send money in either currency; use list_send_destinations for that. The rate is indicative; show get_started_url as the way to continue in the Morse app, where the rate applied to a transfer is shown before the user confirms.

from_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency to convert from, e.g. USD.

to_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency to convert to, e.g. MXN.

name: get_exchange_rate
